race.comment: KLOCKE (7) just ran into one better at Canterbury on debut before going down by the narrowest of margins at Listed level at Eagle Farm. Was then given further time to furnish and has since revved up for this with a recent trial placing. Trust that Waller has him up to the mark and looks the one they all have to run down. GRIDLOCK (4) has placed around this circuit and showed enough when last in work to warrant consideration in a race like this. Can feature while fresh. MOOSE HEAD (8) is facing the starter for the first time but looked handy in a recent trial and any market support must be respected. YENISEI (11) next in line.
